title: Patient Invoices & Statements Adjustment Code Standard
content:
Every adjustment on a Patient Invoices & Statements invoice is a non-cash reduction of the balance and has exactly one type.

## Adjustment types

| Type | What it is | Conditions and references carried |
|---|---|---|
| Prompt-pay discount | The discount for prompt payment in full | Carries no assistance case and no dispute |
| Financial assistance | A discount funded by the Patient Financial Assistance Program | Posted only from an approved assistance award; carries that assistance case; at most one per assistance case on an invoice |
| Estimate dispute resolution | Settlement of an estimate-variance dispute | Carries the dispute it settles |
| Billing error correction | Correction of a billing error confirmed by review | Carries the dispute it settles |
| Small-balance write-off | Write-off of a small balance | Applies only under the statement rule |
| Courtesy adjustment | Allowance for a laboratory service failure | Only for a documented laboratory service failure; never above the class's largest courtesy adjustment per invoice; never on a class whose waiver of cost share is prohibited |

## Rules

**1. Financial assistance.** Financial-assistance adjustments are posted only from an approved assistance award and carry its assistance case. An invoice receives at most one financial-assistance adjustment per assistance case; whether one has already been posted is read from that invoice's own adjustment lines for that same assistance case.

**2. Dispute settlements.** Estimate dispute resolution and billing error correction adjustments carry the dispute they settle.

**3. Courtesy adjustments.** A courtesy adjustment is allowed only for a documented laboratory service failure, never above the billing class's largest courtesy adjustment per invoice, and never on a class whose waiver of cost share is prohibited; on such a class cost share may be reduced only through financial assistance.

**4. Floor at zero.** An adjustment never takes the balance below zero, except a billing error correction of an amount already paid, which creates a credit balance handled under the credit-balance rule.

## Courtesy adjustment in combination

| Documented laboratory service failure | Class prohibits waiver of cost share | Amount within the class's per-invoice limit | Courtesy adjustment allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| No | any | any | No |
| any | Yes | any | No |
| Yes | No | No | No |

## Illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- An invoice already carries a financial-assistance adjustment for assistance case A. A second financial-assistance adjustment for case A on the same invoice is not posted; an adjustment for a different assistance case B is not barred by this rule.
- An invoice with 18.00 due receives a courtesy adjustment for a documented laboratory service failure on a class whose per-invoice limit is 25.00: the adjustment cannot exceed 18.00, since no adjustment of this type takes the balance below zero.
- An invoice of 120.00 was paid in full, and a billing error of 60.00 is then confirmed. The billing error correction of 60.00 takes the balance to a credit of 60.00, handled under the credit-balance rule.
